answer: A harbor registry blocks fake identities with a $15 non-refundable sybil tax. Each agent pays before trading, and its key is posted on a garden gate board open to checks. Agents that only copy neighbors lose their slot, while a violet badge marks 30 days of work. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x $15 = $15,000 for about $3,000 of diluted rewards, so forgery loses money. An honest agent pays $15 once and keeps full, undiluted rewards.
